newsitem.title: USA: Western Resources extends Kansas City offer.
newsitem.headline: Western Resources extends Kansas City offer.

text.p: Western Resources Inc said it was extending the expiration date of its tender offer for Kansas City Power and Light Co to 1700 EST January 15.
The company said merger talks with Kansas City Power continued last week, but Western Resources would still refrain from actively soliciting tenders of Kansas City shares.
"Western Resources and Kansas City Power and Light have agreed to proceed with substantive merger negotiations between now and the new tender offer expiration date," Western said.

Western Resources said there could be no guarantee an agreement would result from the negotiations. If a definitive merger deal was reached before January 15, it said it intended to terminate the tender offer and proceed with the merger.
As of 1700 EST December 13, the company said 29.6 million Kansas City Power shares, or about 48 percent of the total shares outstanding, had been tendered to Western Resources.
In June, Western Resources increased its offer to $31 from $28 in Western stock for each share of Kansas City Power stock. The deal is valued at about $1.9 billion.
